part.text:
Fixed the alignment/zero-flag precedence in `include/fmt/core.h`.

`on_zero()` now sets zero fill and numeric alignment only when no explicit alignment was supplied. Therefore `:<06`, `:>06`, and `:^06` retain their normal space padding, while `:06` continues to zero-pad.

Validation run in the required container:

- `cmake --build build --target format-test -j2`
- `./build/bin/format-test --gtest_filter=format_test.zero_flag_and_align`
- `./build/bin/format-test` (117 tests passed)
- `git diff --check`
